profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I want to create beautiful, interesting and unique projects that utilize both my artistic and technical skills as a 3d artist, and Lighting, Rendering and Effects specialist.

Specialties: adobe aftereffects,  adobe photoshop,  animation,  lighting,  maya,  modeling,  painting,  python,  rendering,  MEL scripting,  video editing, autodesk maya, cinema 4d

positions.description: Lead on 3d Animation projects as well as R&D.

positions.description: Research into various SAT encodings of NP-complete problems. Writing various interfaces for the Picat programming language to various SAT solvers.
